kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Pale Malted White Wheat, Caramel Malted Wheat
kv.Selection notes: This pot distilled wheated bourbon is made with an assertive 32% malted white wheat and 4% caramel malted wheat. Together, these two toasted and roasted specialty wheats contribute rich, sweet notes of honeyed toast, dried apricot, and sweet tea to the whiskey.
kv.Note: Barrel 332 is the “sister” to Barrel 330, which uses malted red wheat instead of malted white wheat. Tasted side-by-side, the two barrels offer a simple but insightful look at how wheat varietal alone can shape flavor.
kv.Tasting notes: Honeyed toast, dried apricot, buttered biscuit, and sweet tea, with a full bodied, warming finish.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Pale Malted Red Wheat, Caramel Malted Wheat
kv.Selection notes: This pot distilled wheated bourbon is made with an assertive 32% malted red wheat and 4% caramel malted wheat. Together, these two toasted and roasted specialty wheats contribute bold notes of graham cracker, dried cherry, and allspice to the whiskey.
kv.Note: Barrel 330 is the “sister” to Barrel 332, which uses malted white wheat instead of malted red wheat. Tasted side-by-side, the two barrels offer a simple but insightful look at how wheat varietal alone can shape flavor.
kv.Tasting notes: Graham cracker, dried cherry, donut, and allspice, with a velvety, warming finish.

kv.Mash Bill: Heritage Floor Malted Barley, Dehusked Pale Malted Barley, Biscuit Malted Barley, Aromatic Malted Barley, Caramel Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: This “single malt” single barrel was crafted from a blend of roasted & toasted specialty malts—including a heritage floor malt from one of the world’s oldest and most historic malt houses in England. The barley variety, known as Maris Otter, was gently toasted over three days in a natural draft kiln, lending the malt a deep, layered complexity.
kv.Tasting notes: Bread pudding, fig jam, cardamom, bay leaf and whipped cream, with a toasted, malty finish.

text: Aged in 18-month seasoned oak barrels, the extended seasoning helps unlock a richer spectrum of vanillin-rich flavor—perfectly complementing the nuanced character of the heritage malt.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Malted Rye, Caramel Malted Barley, Honey Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: Behold! This pot distilled, cask strength version of our signature “Barrel 91” recipe was aged in a barrel that was seasoned for 18 months prior to charring. By exposing the barrel staves to the outdoor elements, natural sugars in the wood are broken down more fully - which thereby increase the amount of caramelization during the barrel charring process. Charred to a level #4, expect a pronounced vanilla character reminiscent of vanilla cream filling.
kv.Tasting notes: Vanilla cream filling, caramel apple, buttered cinnamon toast, and dried fruit, with a lingering peppery spice.

kv.Mash Bill: Wrens Abruzzi Malted Rye (lightly smoked with apple wood), Yellow Corn, Caramel Malted Rye
kv.Selection notes: One of our most unique Experimental rye malt whiskeys to date, this pot distilled rye malt whiskey was made with a highly prized heirloom variety of rye known as Wrens Abruzzi. Known for its pronounced citrus and spice character, the grain’s punchy flavor flavor is enhanced by a very light apple wood smoking, which subtly fills out the whiskey flavor profile with additional richness, without becoming overtly smoky.
kv.Tasting notes: Flamed orange peel, allspice, cinnamon, and vanilla bean, with a hint of clove and black pepper.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Pale Malted Rye, Aromatic Munich Malted Barley, Caramel Aromatic Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: Barrel 308 - the sister barrel to #306 & #307 - contains multiple varieties of "aromatic" malted barley, which undergo a warm sprouting and extended toasting process - thereby enhancing the rich, toasty aromatic qualities of the grain. By aging in a #3 char barrel that was seasoned for 18 months, this alternate version of the recipe expresses a brighter, fresh fruit character, compared to its sister barrels.
kv.Tasting notes: Mixed berry compote, horchata, cream soda, and honey drizzled fig.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Pale Malted Rye, Aromatic Munich Malted Barley, Caramel Aromatic Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: Barrel 307 - the sister barrel to Barrel 306 (and upcoming Barrel 308) - contains multiple varieties of "aromatic" malted barley, which undergo a warm sprouting and extended toasting process - thereby enhancing the rich, toasty aromatic qualities of the grain. By aging in a #4 char barrel that was seasoned for 18-mos, this alternate version of the recipe expresses a more pronounced vanilla and warm cinnamon character, compared to toasted barrel #306.
kv.Tasting notes: Caramel corn, snickerdoodle cookie, black tea, whipped cream, fresh blackberry.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Pale Malted Rye, Aromatic Munich Malted Barley, Caramel Aromatic Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: Barrel 306 showcases an elegant & simple high malt mash bill, which contains two varieties of "aromatic" malted barley. This style of malted grain undergoes a warm sprouting and extended toasting process, which thereby enhances the rich, toasty aromatic qualities of the malt. The resulting straight bourbon whiskey showcases a warm, malty complexity reminiscent of malted milk shake.
kv.Tasting notes: Malted milk shake, dried apricot, fig jam, and a hint of nutmeg.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Pale Malted Rye, Caramel Malted Barley, Honey Malted Barley, Pale Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: Barrel 301 is a pot distilled variation on our signature "Barrel 91" recipe, which substitutes our typical malt whiskey yeast for a traditional bourbon yeast. The resulting bourbon experienced a faster primary fermentation, but longer secondary fermentation...therefore allowing for a more traditional bourbon flavor profile, with a subtle fruit character, balanced toward barrel expression.
kv.Tasting notes: Vanilla cream pie, toasted brioche, fresh figs, dried orange peel, with a hint of black pepper.

kv.Mash Bill: Pale Malted Barley, Floor Malted Barley, "Special B" Dark Caramel Malted Barley, Biscuit Malted Barley, Vienna Malted Barley, Caramel Malted Barley, Aromatic Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: Made with nearly the same mash bill as its sister barrel, Barrel 304, this single malt whiskey also includes the addition of a unique dark caramel malt known as “Special B”. Known to brewers and distillers around the world for its rich, fruity, raisin-like character, a mere 6% of this specialty malted barley contributes more than its share of flavor and aroma. Aged in a lightly toasted and charred oak barrel for 4 years, the dried fruit-forward spirit and lightly toasty cooperage work in harmony to create this one-of-a-kind pot distilled malt whiskey.
kv.Note: Try side-by-side with Barrel 295’s sister barrel: Barrel 304!
kv.Tasting notes: Dried cherries, plum cake, raisin bread pudding, toasted oak, all spice.

kv.Mash Bill: Pale Malted Barley, Floor Malted Barley, Biscuit Malted Barley, Caramel Malted Barley, Aromatic Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: This unique single malt whiskey is made from 5 varieties of roasted and toasted malted barley - one of which was traditionally floor-malted in one of the world's oldest and most historic malt houses in England. This heritage barley variety - known as Maris Otter - was gently toasted over three days in a natural draft kiln, which naturally lends a deeper flavor profile to the malt. Aged in a lightly toasted and charred oak barrel for 4 years, the malty spirit and toasty cooperage work in harmony to create this one-of-a-kind single barrel.
kv.Tasting notes: Baklava, allspice, chocolate banana bread, and anise with a sweet, toasted biscuit finish.

kv.Mash Bill: Malted Dinkel Wheat, Yellow Corn, Pale Malted Barley, Vienna Malted Barley, Munich Malted Barley
kv.Cooperage: #2 char, + toast profile "91", 18 mo. seasoned, 53 gallon
kv.Selection notes: Reserved from the same family of barrels as Experimental Batch 037: Ancient Wheat, this rare single barrel was made from an abundance of malted dinkel wheat. This heirloom wheat varietal - which dates all the way back to the dawn of civilization - contributes a nutty richness to the whiskey no longer found in modern wheat varieties. Aged in a long-seasoned, toasted & charred barrel, the result is a wildly complex and structured dram, merging notes of bright fruit, toast and baked dessert.
kv.Tasting notes: Lemon candy, créme caramel, glazed poppyseed muffin, toasted oak, with a lingering wheaty finish.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Pale Malted Rye, Caramel Malted Barley (light, medium, & dark varieties)
kv.Selection notes: This Experimental Single Barrel elegantly showcases the true power of specialty malted grains. Made with our team's go-to malted rye and a range of 3 kiln roasted caramel malts, this multi-layered mash bill was fermented with two classic yeast strains - common to both bourbon and malt whiskey. The result is a classic pot-distilled Tennessee High Malt: complex yet focused, with notes of caramel, spice, malt, and concentrated fruit.
kv.Tasting notes: Cherry preserves, tea biscuits, milk chocolate caramels, and a hint of clove. Bright, malt-forward palate with a spiced rye finish.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Pale Malted Rye, Naked Malted Oats, Caramel Malted Barley, Smoked Malted Rye, Chocolate Malted Rye, Caramel Malted Rye
kv.Selection notes: This Experimental Single Barrel is a blend of 3 high malt bourbons, which together contain 4 types of roasted and toasted malted rye malts. The combination of pale, smoked, chocolate, and caramel rye malt varieties results in a densely sweet & spicy flavor profile, classically associated with malted rye grain.
kv.Tasting notes: Notes of cinnamon bun, freshly baked rye bread, raw vanilla bean, chai tea with a charred oak finish.

kv.Mash Bill: Appalachian Malted Wheat, Yellow Corn
kv.Selection notes: This one-of-a-kind Experimental Single Barrel was the 1st straight wheat malt whiskey ever made at our Experimental Distillery. Made from a minimalist 2-grain mash bill - consisting of Tennessee-grown malted wheat and local stone-ground yellow corn - this under-appreciated style of whiskey proudly showcases the flavor impact of local grains, and the magic of the malting process.
kv.Tasting notes: Notes of sugar cookie, nutmeg, and toasted almond with a lingering vanilla and tobacco leaf finish

kv.Mash Bill: Pale Malted Barley, Speyside Malted Barley, Aromatic Malted Barley, Light Munich Malted Barley, Chevallier Malted Barley, Dinkel Malted Wheat, Caramel Malted Barley, Yellow Corn
kv.Selection notes: This one-of-a-kind straight malt whiskey utilizes multiple heritage barley varieties from both Scotland and England, prized for their depth of flavor and classic malty richness. Joined by a highly toasted "aromatic" malted barley and a small portion of dinkel malted wheat, this unconventional malt whiskey is a multi-layered, flavor-journey of a dram.
kv.Tasting notes: Orange marmalade, cinnamon scone, caramel apple, and maple syrup on the nose, with notes of tobacco, toasted oak, and baking spice on the palate

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Malted Rye, Caramel Malted Barley, Honey Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: This pot distilled version of our signature "Barrel 91" recipe was aged in a cask that was seasoned for 18 months prior to its charring. By exposing the barrel staves to the outdoor elements, natural sugars in the wood are broken down more fully, and thereby increase the amount of caramelization during the barrel charring process.
kv.Tasting notes: Dark honey, freshly baled hay, and caramel apple

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Pale Malted Barley, Honey Malted Barley, Caramel Malted Rye, Dark "Munich" Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: Aged in a barrel that was lightly toasted prior to charring, this high malt bourbon includes a variety of lightly toasted & caramelized rye and barley malts. Together, the toasted barrel and grains add synergized flavors reminiscent of baking spice, dark fruit and sweet breads.
kv.Tasting notes: Caramel apple, rum raisin ice cream, zucchini bread, baklava and dried apricot

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Pale Malted Barley, CaraMunich Malted Barley, Honey Malted Barley, Aromatic Malted Barley, Caramel Malted Rye, Chocolate Malted Barley, Malted Oats
kv.Selection notes: Bursting with rich, dessert-like flavors, this single barrel owes its layered complexity to the multiple varieties of toasted and roasted barley, rye and oat malts. Discover the contribution of each specialty malt by adding a small amount of water in between each sip of whiskey!
kv.Tasting notes: Caramel, coffee cake on the nose. Butterscotch, cocoa, and light black pepper on the palate

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Peat Smoked Malted Barley, Malted Naked Oats, Honey Malted Barley, Caramel Malted Barley, Malted Rye
kv.Selection notes: Inspired by the rich world of Islay Scotch, this high malt "peated" bourbon was made with a heavy hand of peat smoked malted barley, "naked" malted oats and honey malted barley.
kv.Tasting notes: Earthy smoke, ripe fruit, and toasted granola

text: Collector's note: This barrel and its recipe are artifacts from one of our first Experimental Batches: Batch 004, which was made with a nearly identical high malt mash bill.

kv.Mash Bill: Five varieties of Pale Malted Barley, Aromatic Malted Barley, Light Munich Malted Barley, Pale Malted Rye
kv.Selection notes: This unique single barrel – known to our distillers as a “catch single barrel” – contains malt whiskey from multiple recipes and distillation runs. Over the course of 10 months, each recipe's distillate topped up the barrel and reset the age. Once completely full, the whiskey was aged for over 4 years in a heavily toasted and charred barrel, before bottling.
kv.Tasting notes: Lightly floral with notes of white grape, grapefruit brûlée, meringue and tobacco leaf. Warming, full bodied finish with a touch of clove.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Cob Smoked Malted Barley, Appalachian Malted Wheat
kv.Selection notes: This one-of-a-kind single barrel was made with 18% corn cob-smoked malted barley, made for us by Valley Malt (Holyoke, MA) using cobs from our distillery's corn!
kv.Tasting notes: Honey baked ham, sticky toffee pudding, date jam and charred oak, with a full bodied & sweet-smoky finish.

text: Collector's note: This barrel and recipe are artifacts from one of our first Experimental Batches: Batch 003, which utilized the same cob-smoked malt in its finishing barrel's mash bill.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, White Corn, Pale Malted Barley, Flaked Barley, Malted Rye, Caramel Malted Barley, Honey Malted Barley
kv.Selection notes: This unique single barrel – known to our distillers as a “catch single barrel” – contains bourbon whiskey from multiple recipes and distillation runs. Over the course of 8 months, each recipe's distillate topped up the barrel and reset the age. Once completely full, the whiskey was aged for over 4 years in a heavily toasted and charred barrel.
kv.Tasting notes: Chantilly cream, toasted hazelnut, cinnamon toast, vanilla bean, rum cake

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Simpsons Peated Malted Barley, Honey Malted Barley, Malted Rye
kv.Selection Notes: This peated bourbon was made with peat smoked malt made by Simpsons Malt in Northumberland, UK. This single barrel, and its sister barrel, #213 have identical mash bills - except for their peated malts - which were malted and smoked by a different maltster.
kv.Tasting notes: Briny smoke, honey & oats, shortbread cookie and bread pudding.

kv.Mash Bill: Yellow Corn, Thomas Fawcett Peated Malted Barley, Honey Malted Barley, Malted Rye
kv.Selection Notes: This peated bourbon was made with peat smoked malt made by Simpsons Malt in Northumberland, UK. This single barrel, and its sister barrel, #206 have identical mash bills - except for their peated malts - which were malted and smoked by a different maltster.
kv.Tasting notes: Sweet earthy smoke, toffee pudding, apple crisp and caramel candy.
